all_catalog_texts.SUG_LIGHTING_01: Uneven lighting can exaggerate shadows and skew readings. Retake facing a window or soft front light without harsh side shadows.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_POSE_RETAKE_01: A slight head turn can change measured proportions. Retake centered to the camera with eyes level and chin parallel to the floor.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_SYM_HIGH_01: Left–right alignment shows elevated asymmetry. Retake with face centered and even lighting before drawing styling conclusions.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_FACE_ASPECT_LOW_01: Face width relative to height reads below your typical band. Soft volume at the sides of the hair can balance a longer vertical look in photos.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_FACE_ASPECT_HIGH_01: Face width relative to height reads above your typical band. Lengthening styles or center-part framing can refine the silhouette in photos.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_MIDFACE_LOW_01: Midface length reads below your typical band. Soft highlight on the cheekbones can add lift and openness in makeup applications.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_MIDFACE_HIGH_01: Midface length reads above your typical band. Contouring just under the cheekbones can shorten the midface visually in photos.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_LOWERFACE_LOW_01: Lower face length reads below your typical band. Keeping bangs shorter or swept up can open the lower third visually.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_LOWERFACE_HIGH_01: Lower face length reads above your typical band. Soft fringe or volume at mid-length hair can balance a longer lower third in photos.
all_catalog_texts.SUG_JAW_NARROW_01: Jaw width sits below the typical band. Soft contour along the jawline and side hair density can add visual structure in photos.

all_catalog_texts.SUG_CHIN_SHORT_01: Chin length reads below your typical band. A soft highlight on the chin tip can add projection for photos.

all_catalog_texts.SUG_CHIN_WIDE_01: Chin width reads wider than your typical band. Narrower vertical highlight and soft side contour can refine the tip in photos.
